in_marathi.name: Sharita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shri', which means 'goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity'. The suffix 'ita' means 'that which is'. Thus, Sharita can be interpreted as 'the goddess of love and beauty'.
